from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyRevenue(BaseModel):
    """Revenue figure from a single company's 10-Q filing for the period in question."""
    company: str = Field(description="Company name as named in the filing")
    revenue_amount: float = Field(description="Total revenues/net sales amount reported")
    revenue_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale of the amount: 'millions', 'thousands', 'dollars'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., 'three months ended March 31, 2025')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line containing the revenue figure and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_revenues: list[CompanyRevenue]
